text_02: Breath as a doorway to deeper awareness.
text_03: In addition to talk therapy, I offer neurodynamic-style breathwork sessions for clients who are interested in experiential, body-based practices. These sessions use intentional, connected breathing, carefully curated music, and guided integration to help you access deeper layers of emotion, insight, and nervous system regulation.
text_04: Breathwork can support release of stored tension, increase access to emotion, and help you connect with a quieter, wiser part of yourself. It is not a replacement for therapy or medical care, but can be a powerful complement to ongoing work when approached with respect, preparation, and consent.
text_05: We will always discuss your history, intentions, and any medical or psychological considerations before incorporating breathwork. You remain in choice throughout the process, and we move at a pace that feels safe for your body and nervous system.

text_10: Accessing insight around patterns and values
text_11: Integrating therapeutic work on a felt, embodied level
text_12: Breathwork can be incorporated for existing therapy clients where clinically appropriate, or discussed as a separate experiential offering.
